column3: “Face to face” replaces mouth with mouth; “see him eye to eye” renders his eyes seeing the other’s eyes.
“Signed” specifies writing in the document; “called in” renders causing witnesses to testify.
“Copy” identifies the sealed and open documents.
“My cousin” replaces the designation my uncle at this point.
“Copies” specifies the documents; “a long time” renders many days.
“Laps” renders the bosom of the sons.
The eyes are open upon the ways; “reward” specifies giving to each.
“Give their fathers” replaces the wording about giving it to them after swearing to their fathers.
“They” in the second clause replaces the repeated sons of Israel.
